name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Drift and Forge, one goes with Bauer and the other with Eklund.
Either Bauer goes with Beacon or Drift goes with Eklund.
Anders' distance is between Eklund and Cho.
Helix goes with exactly one of 7 ly, 9 ly, or 10 ly.
The colonist in the Aurora module's distance is exactly 2 ly more than Bauer.
Okafor, Drift, and 7 ly belong to different colonists.
Either Bauer goes with Drift, or Okafor goes with 9 ly — but not both.
The colonist in the Drift module's distance is lower than both Anders and Cho.
